/* AuthGroupMapper.selectAuthGroupList 조회 조건에 맞는 권한그룹 목록을 그룹코드 순으로 조회 */ SELECT USR_GRP_CD, COALESCE(USR_GRP_NM, '') AS USR_GRP_NM, USE_YN, COALESCE(ST_DT, '') AS ST_DT, COALESCE(END_DT, '') AS END_DT, COALESCE(RMK, '') AS RMK FROM TB_AUTH_GRP_M G
ORDER BY USR_GRP_CD
/* AuthGroupMapper.existsAuthGroup 권한그룹이 등록되어 있는지 판별 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_AUTH_GRP_M WHERE USR_GRP_CD = #{usrGrpCd})
mapper.update: /* AuthGroupMapper.updateAuthGroup 권한그룹을 수정 */ UPDATE TB_AUTH_GRP_M SET USR_GRP_NM = #{item.usrGrpNm}, USE_YN = #{item.useYn}, ST_DT = NULLIF(#{item.stDt}, ''), END_DT = NULLIF(#{item.endDt}, ''), RMK = NULLIF(#{item.rmk}, ''), FINA_REGR_ID = #{regrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USR_GRP_CD = #{item.usrGrpCd}
mapper.insert: /* AuthGroupMapper.insertAuthGroupComponent 권한그룹 컴포넌트 권한을 등록 (이미 있으면 권한여부 수정) */ INSERT INTO TB_AUTH_GRP_CMPN_R ( USR_GRP_CD, PRGM_ID, CMPN_ID, AUTH_YN, FIRS_REGR_ID, FIRS_REG_DT, FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{item.usrGrpCd}, #{item.prgmId}, #{item.cmpnId}, #{item.authYn}, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{regrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (USR_GRP_CD, PRGM_ID, CMPN_ID) DO UPDATE SET AUTH_YN = EXCLUDED.AUTH_YN, FINA_REGR_ID = EXCLUDED.FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
/* AuthGroupMapper.selectAuthGroupUserCountList 조회 조건에 맞는 권한그룹 목록을 그룹별 사용자수와 함께 그룹코드 순으로 조회 */ SELECT G.USR_GRP_CD, COALESCE(G.USR_GRP_NM, '') AS USR_GRP_NM, G.USE_YN, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USR_AUTH_GRP_R R WHERE R.USR_GRP_CD = G.USR_GRP_CD) AS USR_CNT FROM TB_AUTH_GRP_M G
ORDER BY G.USR_GRP_CD

/* AuthGroupMapper.selectAuthGroupUserList 권한그룹에 속한 사용자 목록을 사용자ID 순으로 조회 */ SELECT R.USR_GRP_CD, R.USR_ID, COALESCE(U.USR_NM, '') AS USR_NM, COALESCE(U.USR_CLS_CD, '') AS USR_CLS_CD, COALESCE(U.DEPT_CD, '') AS DEPT_CD FROM TB_USR_AUTH_GRP_R R JOIN TB_USR_M U ON U.USR_ID = R.USR_ID WHERE R.USR_GRP_CD = #{usrGrpCd} ORDER BY R.USR_ID
